consent.body: The platform draws your attention to the fact that everything you list, whether goods or services, is your own personal responsibility, and that you must ensure it is accurate and matches how you describe it. The platform verifies only that you are from the South, and does not stand behind the dealing between you and the buyer. Where a legal violation is established, you will be removed from the platform.
consent.buyerBody: The platform draws your attention to the fact that every dealing made through it is your own responsibility. The platform verifies only that those listing are southerners; it guarantees neither the agreement between you and them nor the accuracy of what they list. Check carefully and responsibly before buying or hiring.
consent.heading: Before you continue
consent.jobSeekerBody: When you receive a job offer in any form, verifying the identity of the party offering it, the nature of their business and the accuracy of their information is your own legal responsibility, so that no deception or manipulation can take hold. Check carefully and responsibly.

growth.offerDefault:
The Janoubona offer: your page selling within 48 hours, free

The outcome
New customers from the South and the diaspora that supports it, with orders coming straight to your WhatsApp.

What we do for you
• We build your page from photos you send on WhatsApp. No forms.
• We write your product descriptions, set the prices and crop the photos.
• Your page is published within 48 hours of the photos arriving.
• A "Share on WhatsApp" button for your page and every product.

Bonuses
• A spot on the Janoubona channel and in the home page stories.
• A counter showing how often your page was opened.
• A place in the Janoubona sellers' group: tips, experience and requests.

The guarantee
Free, with no commission and no subscription. If you get no order within 30 days, we improve your product photos and promote your page on the channel at our cost.

Who it is for
Every displaced southerner, and every southerner who works or produces in the South.

Why now
Free page building by our team is open to the first 100 shops in this phase.

setupMap.entry.app.title: Claude app / web
setupMap.entry.app.details: Where the team asks Claude directly; it works on a copy of the repo and sends changes as pull requests.
setupMap.entry.board.title: Ticket board
setupMap.entry.board.short: Staff file tickets in the admin
setupMap.entry.board.details: Every problem or request becomes a ticket with a screenshot and the page it came from, which Claude reads and works on.
setupMap.entry.routine.title: Scheduled routine
setupMap.entry.routine.details: Takes one ticket per run, fixes it, opens a pull request and comments on the ticket. Also starts at once when a ticket moves to TODO or APPROVED.
setupMap.entry.telegram.title: Telegram «approve» button
setupMap.entry.telegram.short: Approve a ticket from the chat
setupMap.entry.telegram.details: When a fix is ready, a Telegram message arrives with a button to approve it; it is then released to the live site.
setupMap.center.claude.title: Claude Code
setupMap.center.claude.details: Reads the project rules first, works on a branch, opens a pull request, waits for checks, merges to develop, releases to live on your OK and checks both sites.
setupMap.center.subagents.title: Subagents
setupMap.center.subagents.details: Large work can be split across agents running in parallel; today we mostly work with one.
setupMap.harness.rules.title: AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md
setupMap.harness.rules.details: Read before every job: commands, security rules, what never to touch and deployment lessons. The first reference.
setupMap.harness.skills.title: Skills
setupMap.harness.skills.details: Pre-push checks, driving a pull request, releasing to live and the ticket pass: each a fixed set of steps that does not change between sessions.
setupMap.harness.permissions.title: Permissions
setupMap.harness.permissions.details: Allowed commands are listed, but nothing forbids, for example, reading secret files or pushing straight to the live branch.
setupMap.harness.plan.title: Plan mode
setupMap.harness.plan.short: A plan you approve before any code
setupMap.harness.plan.details: Claude writes the plan first and only builds after you approve it.
setupMap.harness.memory.title: Memory
setupMap.harness.memory.short: Lessons written into the rules by hand
setupMap.harness.memory.details: When a mistake repeats it is written into the rules or a skill, but by hand, not automatically.
setupMap.harness.hooks.title: Hooks
setupMap.harness.hooks.details: Scripts that always run whatever the model decides: block dangerous commands, check each edited file, and run the quick checks before any task is called done.
setupMap.tools.github.title: GitHub
setupMap.tools.github.details: Where the code lives: every change goes through a reviewable pull request, and check results are read here.
setupMap.tools.railway.title: Railway
setupMap.tools.railway.details: Where both sites run. Claude reads logs and deploy status and adds keys when asked.
setupMap.tools.sentry.title: Sentry
setupMap.tools.sentry.details: Records any error on the site, with the release that caused it.
setupMap.tools.south.title: South tool (MCP)
setupMap.tools.south.short: Read the directory, write tickets only
setupMap.tools.south.details: Lets Claude read shops, products and tickets and write only to the ticket board, with owners' identity hidden.
setupMap.tools.playwright.title: Test browser
setupMap.tools.playwright.details: A browser that opens pages as a visitor would, to check a change before it ships.
setupMap.tools.web.title: Web search / fetch
setupMap.tools.web.details: To read external services' docs, such as the SMS provider's.
setupMap.tools.reviewer.title: Second AI reviewer
setupMap.tools.reviewer.details: Another model reviews each change before merge, looking for what the first missed. Optional; needs another account.
setupMap.checks.ci.title: 4 required CI checks
setupMap.checks.ci.details: Nothing merges until all four pass: over 900 tests each time.
setupMap.checks.guards.title: Guard tests
setupMap.checks.guards.short: Rules that cannot be broken by mistake
setupMap.checks.guards.details: No Arabic in code, staff permissions, owners' identity never public, no dropping tables with data, private files stay private.
setupMap.checks.preflight.title: Release pre-flight
setupMap.checks.preflight.details: Before each release, Claude checks live has nothing develop lacks and lists any database change.
setupMap.checks.visual.title: Visual review
setupMap.checks.visual.details: Screenshots are taken by hand, with no fixed phone, tablet and desktop pass.
setupMap.checks.localgate.title: Local gate before «done»
setupMap.checks.localgate.details: Quick checks are not enforced before pushing, so small mistakes reach CI and delay the fix.
setupMap.ship.develop.title: Develop
setupMap.ship.develop.details: Every passing change lands here first and can be tried before release.
setupMap.ship.master.title: Live
setupMap.ship.master.details: Nothing reaches it except a release on your OK, after which Claude checks both sites.
setupMap.ship.backups.title: Backups
setupMap.ship.backups.short: Daily and at every start, plus Amazon S3
setupMap.ship.backups.details: The database is copied to storage and S3 and sent to Telegram every 3 hours.
setupMap.ship.telegram.title: Telegram
setupMap.ship.telegram.details: The group receives everything users add, staff notices and approval requests.
setupMap.knowledge.repo.title: Git repo
setupMap.knowledge.repo.details: Every change is kept with why it was made.
setupMap.knowledge.claude.title: The .claude folder
setupMap.knowledge.claude.details: Where skills and permissions live, carried into every new session.
setupMap.knowledge.docs.title: docs/
setupMap.knowledge.docs.details: Written explanations of how the site works, for Claude and the team.
setupMap.knowledge.locales.title: Locale catalogs
setupMap.knowledge.locales.short: All site text in Arabic and English
setupMap.knowledge.locales.details: No text inside the code; every word a visitor sees is in one easy-to-edit file.
setupMap.knowledge.design.title: DESIGN.md
setupMap.knowledge.design.details: One file for the site's visual identity, so every new page matches.
setupMap.knowledge.handoff.title: HANDOFF.md
setupMap.knowledge.handoff.details: What waits for approval and which keys are missing, so nothing is lost when a new session starts.
setupMap.knowledge.board.title: Ticket board
setupMap.knowledge.board.details: A full record of everything asked for and done.
